runtimeEvidence.stateSidecarExplanation: one state_header plus one state record

stale_state.probe: fresh archive hash, receipt, payload manifest, source SHA/tree, and zero product diff were cross-checked rather than reusing success prose

dirty_worktree.probe: tracked dirt is confined to .omo plan/notepad/ledger state; git diff from the exact source commit excluding .omo is empty

misleading_success_output.probe: raw archive bytes, provenance, JSONL event types/counts, metadata counts, fixture execution, and rejection exits were inspected independently

malformed_input.probe: isolated malformed receipt rejected with exit 1

flaky_tests.probe: dedicated-smoke.json and published-smoke.json are separate successful live runs with the same semantic result; two retained static passes plus a fresh static pass agree

hung_or_long_commands.probe: fresh static, fixture, wrong-SHA, and malformed-input checks used 30-60 second outer timeouts and completed in under two seconds total

repeated_interruptions.reason: the independent pass created no resumable production operation and did not interrupt publication

cancel_resume.reason: publication was already complete and verification was read-only

prompt_injection.reason: no untrusted instruction-text or model-routing surface is involved

removeAiSlops.note: No useless deletion-only test or tautological runtime proof controls this verdict.
